candidate.api: standard Messages API (the final run uses the Batch API at half price)

note: 30 cases: diagnostic, not a population estimate. Human labels were made without seeing any model output; 3 emoji-only intents were changed from complaint to unclear after the labeller was reminded of the written rubric rule (still blind to model output).
scoring: strict: one primary human label per field (alternatives ignored)

selection.method: lowest sha256(seed + ':' + review_id) among low-confidence texts (first review ID per text), golden IDs excluded
